items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: Franz Jackson was there and he -- and 'Didn't He Ramble' on the way back from the funeral and all of that.

ctx.x: Right, I told about it. Well, anyway, -- and we had the New Orleans thing and we did the whole bit about New Orleans. And we did the funeral things. Franz Jackson was there and he -- and "Didn't He Ramble" on the way back from the funeral and all of that. It was beautiful, and they enjoyed it so much.
What kind of work have you been getting the last few years? I heard you with Little Brother Montgomery and (unintelligible) Art Hodes.
